purpose: Resolve the v1 reverse-composition power failure with an outcome-free activation-norm-matched Task14-derived stressor, while leaving original-gain two-sided composition unclaimed.

prior_art_search.result: The v1 bracket panel preserved its program but Task14 stress was only 0.0004896 of bracket-effect norm, below the frozen 0.05 power bar. No norm-matched stress result exists.

gain.definition: statistics.median of six bracket vector L2 norms divided by statistics.median of ten Task14 cardinality-vector L2 norms, recomputed from immutable coordinates

predictions.pred_a_immutable_artifacts_gain_and_corn: Artifact hashes hold, recomputed gain matches within 1e-12, all 144 bracket OOD endpoints have four corners, and the isolated bracket corner replays within 1e-4.
predictions.pred_b_norm_matched_task14_stress_is_liv: Scaled Task14 stress has L2 norm at least 0.05 of isolated bracket program-effect norm.
predictions.pred_c_bracket_program_is_robust: Bracket effects under scaled Task14 stress versus isolated effects have cosine at least 0.90, relative L2 at most 0.40, signs at least 0.90, and interaction/own norm at most 0.40.
predictions.pred_d_no_original_gain_upgrade: The result is labeled norm-matched robustness only and does not promote original-gain reverse or two-sided composition.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_price: At most one physical forward, 576 example evaluations, zero backwards, fits, updates, vector selection changes, or outcome-conditioned gains.

terminal_rule: robustness_screen if all gates pass; interaction_null if instrument/live-stress pass but robustness fails; inconclusive if stress remains weak; invalid otherwise.
